steps: 1. Customer registers in mobile app or is onboarded by Admin.
2. Database trigger or API computes next sequential batch ID (e.g. AMU-A001..AMU-A999, then AMU-B001).
3. Password is hashed using SHA-256 with project salt before storage.
4. Address is geocoded with latitude and longitude coordinates for map route plotting.
5. Subscription record is created with daily quantity (e.g. 1.0L) and delivery timing.
1. Nightly automated cron triggers generate_daily_deliveries_for_date(CURRENT_DATE + 1).
2. System inspects all customers with ACTIVE subscriptions.
3. Verifies no APPROVED cancellation_requests exist for target date and shift.
4. Resolves custom product rate or standard milk rate.
5. Inserts delivery records with status = 'SCHEDULED'.
6. Admin dispatcher reviews stop clusters and assigns delivery_partners.
1. Delivery partner logs in, taps 'Start Trip' (records starting odometer and logs start_partner_trip).
2. Deliveries transition to 'IN_TRANSIT'.
3. Partner arrives at customer location, taps 'Out for Delivery'.
4. Driver delivers fresh chilled glass bottles, collects empty bottles from previous day.
5. Driver enters empty bottle count, selects cash collected (if any) or confirms zero payment.
6. Driver submits 'Complete Delivery' -> calls complete_order_delivery RPC.
7. Physical deliveries row is updated to 'DELIVERED', bottle_allocations are recorded, payments are updated, and real-time delivery_stats are recalculated.
8. Customer app receives instant realtime update via Supabase replication.
1. Partner completes all route stops and returns to Dairy Hub.
2. Partner submits collected cash to Cashier/Accounts Staff.
3. Admin opens 'Settlements' in Milk-admin, verifying expected cash vs handed-over cash.
4. Admin marks settlement as 'SETTLED' or flags variance in `settlements`.
5. Customer payments records update to PAID, closing daily/weekly billing cycle invoices.

stored_functions.purpose: Generates sequential enterprise customer identifiers formatted as AMU-A001 through AMU-Z999, followed by multi-letter batch overflow (AMU-AA001, etc.).

stored_functions.name: trg_assign_amu_customer_id()
stored_functions.purpose: Automatically assigns the next batch customer ID when a new record is inserted into `customers` without an explicit customer_id.

stored_functions.name: fn_customers_prevent_empty_and_duplicate_mobile()
stored_functions.purpose: Validates and sanitizes mobile phone numbers on customer creation/update, strictly prohibiting duplicates and empty phone numbers.

stored_functions.name: fn_sync_deliveries_order_fields()
stored_functions.purpose: Maintains bidirectional synchronization between legacy order columns and the unified physical deliveries table.

stored_functions.name: update_allocation_metrics_on_delivery()
stored_functions.purpose: Automatically updates partner bottle and milk inventory balances upon marking a delivery as DELIVERED or FAILED.

stored_functions.name: fn_group_orders_by_location(p_order_ids text[], p_location_name text, p_assigned_partner_id text)
stored_functions.return_type: TABLE(order_id text, customer_name text, status text)
stored_functions.purpose: Clusters multiple deliveries geographically into an optimized route stop list assigned to a single delivery person.

stored_functions.name: start_partner_trip(p_partner_id text, p_shift text, p_start_odometer numeric)
stored_functions.purpose: Initializes a delivery trip for a partner, creates a `partner_trips` entry, marks assignments IN_TRANSIT, and logs starting vehicle mileage.

stored_functions.name: start_trip_for_partner(p_partner_id text, p_shift text, p_start_km numeric)

stored_functions.name: confirm_start_delivery(p_delivery_id text, p_partner_id text)
stored_functions.purpose: Updates delivery status to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY when the driver navigates towards the customer doorstep.

stored_functions.purpose: Recomputes real-time progress metrics (assigned, delivered, pending, bottles out/in, total cash) on `delivery_stats`.

security_architecture.password_hashing: Client-side and server-side SHA-256 with custom project salt ('amudham_milk_secure_salt_2026')
security_architecture.input_sanitization: SecurityUtils.sanitizeMobileDigits (removes +91, dashes, spaces) & SecurityUtils.sanitizePostgrestParam (prevents PostgREST SQL injection and invalid UUID casting)
security_architecture.token_handling: Supabase JWT authentication with anonymous key and row-level authorization

delivery_status_lifecycle: SCHEDULED: Generated by nightly cron from active subscriptions
ASSIGNED: Delivery partner assigned to the stop/route
PREPARING: Chilled glass bottles bottled and packed into partner crates
IN_TRANSIT: Partner departs dairy hub and commences delivery route
OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: Driver within 500 meters of customer doorstep
DELIVERED: Physical handover complete, bottles returned, confirmed in app
FAILED: Customer unavailable, gate locked, or delivery aborted with reason
CANCELLED: Customer paused delivery before cutoff or admin cancelled

bottle_accounting.exchange_rule: 1-for-1 return model: customer returns empty bottle from previous day upon receiving fresh bottle.

order_cutoff_rules.evening_shift_cutoff: 14:00 PM same day for evening 17:00-19:00 PM delivery

referral_rules.referrer_reward: ₹100 Milk Wallet credit credited upon referee completing 7 successful delivery days
referral_rules.referee_discount: ₹50 instant discount applied to first subscription cycle

for_future_developers: Always maintain idempotency in database changes using IF NOT EXISTS and ON CONFLICT clauses.
Pin 'SET search_path = public, pg_temp' on all PostgreSQL stored procedures to satisfy Supabase security advisor standards.
Never store plain text passwords; always route through SecurityUtils.hashPassword with salt.
When adding columns to deliveries, update the updatable orders VIEW and its INSTEAD OF triggers to preserve backward compatibility.
Delivery partner and customer IDs use standardized alphanumeric strings (AMU-A001, DP-001, STF-1001) rather than UUIDs to avoid client-side casting errors.
Check RLS policies whenever creating new tables to guarantee customers cannot access other customers' records or staff credentials.
for_ai_models_and_agents: When queried about the data model, refer directly to 'server_data_store.tables' for exact column names, constraints, and data types.

When generating Supabase queries, note that the customer app connects with the Anon key and queries 'customers', 'deliveries', 'payments', and 'cancellation_requests' using customer_id or phone matching.
When asked to add an API endpoint or screen, integrate with 'AuthContext.tsx' and 'ServerAPI' in 'src/services/api.ts'.
All financial mutations (payments, settlements, commissions) must verify matching currency units (NUMERIC(10,2)) and maintain audit log entries.
